acceptance: Accept only the proved map, operator relation or specific mismatch. If no match, physical calibration remains open even when the counterexample is decisive. Full-time information must remain distinct from fitted slopes; no continuum promotion.

definitions.conditional_generator: At kappa=zeta=0, H_c=c(C_U+C_V+C_W), c>0 in energy units, domain H2(SU2^3) intersect Hcond, ground1. The more general inherited divergence-form mobility generator may be considered only with its weighted state/domain restated explicitly.
definitions.desired_relation: A bounded L2 extension preserving the declared state and a core intertwining R H_E=H_c R, with common t/hbar. Test any scalar adjustment against the actual ground condition. State separately if only a compression or pointwise section exists.
definitions.fit_and_holdout: Determine c from the nonzero initial imaginary-time slope of training F9 versus x only. Do not fit c again. Reserve F16 versus w full imaginary-time dependence, including t_star=hbar/alpha, as a held-out comparison. These are analytic model predictions, not measured calibration data.
definitions.map: R F(U,V,W)=F(g) evaluated at g_28=U at(1,1,0), g_27=V at(1,0,0), g_24=W at(0,0,0), all other30 links identity. Initially a map on the smooth physical invariant core, not presumed bounded/closable or a true gauge fixing.
definitions.observables: Training physical normalized fundamental face Wilson F9=f9_xz_010, whose inherited section is x=Tr U/2. Held-out physical F16=f16_yz_100, whose section is w=Tr(U V^dagger)/2. Use complex-centered correlation convention <A Omega,exp(-tH/hbar) B Omega> minus the two means, and retain nonzero variance. Other actual graph faces or character channels may be used as discriminating core/map controls.
definitions.parameters: E_star>0, fixed alpha/E_star>0, hbar>0 and lattice spacing a>0; graph volume fixed. alpha and c have energy units; c is a proposed conditional clock coefficient to be tested from one training channel. kappa=zeta=0 are explicit model endpoints. Observation time has time units; representation index, if used, is a discrete test-function label, not a regulator limit of the physical theory.
definitions.physical_generator: H_E=alpha sum_(33 edges) C_e, C_e=-sum_(a=1..3)(L_e^a)^2 with T_a=-i sigma_a/2 and fundamental Casimir3/4. Self-adjoint domain H2(SU2^33) intersect Hphys; smooth invariant functions/Peter-Weyl polynomials form the declared test core.
definitions.topology_and_error: Require L2-norm continuity/closability for a Hilbert reduction and exact generator relation on the invariant smooth core. If it fails, quantify a core or norm defect and distinguish it from approximate matching on only the selected observables. Do not infer an L2 bounded map from evaluation of smooth functions.

graph_boundary: Complete18 vertices,33 positively oriented links and20 elementary faces in0<=x,y<=2,0<=z<=1; all endpoints have vertex Gauss action, no charged boundary. Actual signed-face ledger is inherited C1.
model: Finite SU2 full-link electric lattice endpoint on the actual C1 four-cube graph; magnetic coefficient explicitly zero. Compare a declared conditional three-link generator. This changes the model from interacting J2/O and supplies no transfer to either or to continuum Yang–Mills.
next_loop: P2 selected only after P1 skeptical review. Q/R unselected until all six N/O/P reviews.
proposed_not_accepted: The static C1 section may define a state-compatible physical reduction with one common conditional generator coefficient c. Its training-slope fit may also reproduce the reserved full-time channel. Both claims must be tested.
representation: Physical Hphys=L2(SU2^33,Haar^33) invariant under all18 vertex gauge transformations. Conditional Hcond=L2(SU2^3,Haar^3) invariant under simultaneous conjugation. Both use normalized Haar and constant cyclic ground1 for the declared electric/product endpoints.
required: Reconstruct or independently verify the actual full graph and signed face restrictions; distinguish fixing30 links from a legitimate complete gauge reduction.

Prove or refute the stated L2 map extension and state/domain relation. Use a valid invariant smooth-core sequence or equivalent decisive check where appropriate; avoid unsupported trace-theorem claims.
Evaluate the core generator intertwining, including scalar shifts and all electric derivatives of links that were fixed in the static section.
Derive the training slope and common c if its variance is nonzero, then evaluate the reserved full-time channel with exact eigenvalues or certified bounds at the same physical clock.

If the map or matching fails, establish the precise mismatch/underidentification and propose a justified next map repair to be selected only after review. No claim that all physical reductions are impossible.

Use targeted primary gauge-Hilbert/Casimir source checks at their actual reading depth, independent exact controls, normal/optimized fresh outputs and complete frozen source closure. Preserve distinction from K1 same-coordinate symbol and L2 finite-slope results.
